set.body:
Selection -> new release -> share by name -> explain -> revoke.

Source: docs/build-plan.md, section 8, package 11.

Architecture assessment, 18 November 2026

ARC07 owns the fixed-release share and current-grants portion. For D11, use the existing packaged view-preparation route, select a supported subset, preview and accept it as its own release, then use ARC07 to share, explain and revoke. The recipient can retrieve exactly the expected permitted subset. Record the browser receipt and independent membership and byte checks.
